    if v1 == v2:
        return v1 * t
    
    if v1 < v2:
        # Increase speed
        steps_to_increase = min(t - 1, (v2 - v1) // d)
        remaining_time = t - steps_to_increase
        final_speed = v1 + steps_to_increase * d
        return sum(range(v1, final_speed + 1)) + (final_speed * remaining_time)
    
    else:
        # Decrease speed
        steps_to_decrease = min(t - 1, (v1 - v2) // d)
        remaining_time = t - steps_to_decrease
        final_speed = v1 - steps_to_decrease * d
        return sum(range(final_speed, v1 + 1)) + (final_speed * remaining_time)
